text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! It seems like you're steadily<n>collecting
trophies!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Ha-ha-ha! Just as I expected of you!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Many thanks! We're one step closer to<n>my
boundless dream!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However! The present amount of<n>trophies is not
enough to fill this room<n>with brilliance!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Continue on! I'm counting on you to<n>keep up the
good work!
